pages.title: LN Tower
pages.text: The LN Tower does not deal direct damage, but it applies a 5-second slow effect to enemies, making it a crowd control-type turret.$(br2)Attack Range: 15 m$(br)Attack Interval：5 s$(br)Consumption: 10 $(efu)
